description: You are a GRC/Compliance Engineer at a financial services company preparing for a PCI DSS assessment. The security team needs to demonstrate that Wazuh implements the audit log monitoring controls required by PCI DSS Requirement 10 (Track and Monitor All Access to Network Resources and Cardholder Data). Currently there are no PCI-specific controls implemented in Wazuh. Your goal is to implement the following: (1) create and deploy a custom Security Configuration Assessment (SCA) policy YAML file with at least 5 distinct compliance checks targeting PCI DSS Requirement 10 controls — for example: audit log enabled, log integrity monitoring, time synchronization configured, privileged access events logged, and failed authentication events logged — and save it to the Wazuh shared directory; (2) update ossec.conf to include email alerting configuration with SMTP server, from address, and to address specified; (3) create at least two custom detection rules at severity level 10 or higher that detect PCI DSS Requirement 10 violations such as unauthorized privileged access, audit log file modification, or repeated failed authentication patterns; and (4) write a compliance evidence document to /home/ga/Desktop/pci_compliance_report.txt of at least 800 characters that documents each implemented control and maps it to its corresponding PCI DSS Requirement 10 sub-requirement (10.1 through 10.7). Log in to the Wazuh dashboard at https://localhost with username admin, password SecretPassword.
